portal_hypertension.title: Stereotactic body radiotherapy and other locoregional therapies for hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with cirrhosis: real-world treatment allocation, BCLC-stratified outcomes, and prognostic determinants.
portal_hypertension.authors: Philips CA, Oommen TT, Paul J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：立体定向全身放射治疗 (SBRT) 已成为不适合热消融或手术的肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患者的一种治疗选择。 临床提示：然而，关于医生如何选择局部治疗、这些治疗决策的特定阶段结果以及超越治疗方式的预后决定因素的现实证据仍然存在。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Stereotactic body radiotherapy (SBRT) has emerged as a treatment option for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in patients ineligible for thermal ablation or surgery. However, real-world evidence on how physicians select between locoregional therapies, the stage-specific outcomes of these treatment decisions, and the prognostic determinants that transcend treatment modality remains limited.
